document.title: Collapse sources and scroll after three rows
document.summary: The sources list on the overview and on each group starts closed. Opening it shows three rows; further sources scroll inside that list.
document.why: Sources are a secondary part of the brief and often take a lot of vertical space.

sources.label: Sources collapse scroll
sources.gist: Make sources collapsible, collapsed by default, with room for three rows and a scroll for the rest.

groups.title: Collapsible sources
groups.why: [The request](source:s1) asks for sources to stay out of the way until opened, and to show at most three rows.
groups.summary: `SourceList` renders a closed disclosure. When it is open and there are more than three sources, the list height is the first three rows and the rest scroll.
